messages.content: It's extremely hot today and my air conditioner is currently turned off. Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. power off after an hour

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Sends a command to control an appliance, allowing only a single value to be sent in one call. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the parameters for the appliance command.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Whether air quality sensor monitoring is enabled.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air cleaning function.

airConOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air conditioner, indicating if it is turned on or off.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Whether power save mode is enabled to conserve energy.

targetTemperature.description: The target temperature to set for the appliance, in degrees Celsius.

relativeHourToStop.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeMinuteToStop.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeHourToStart.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

relativeMinuteToStart.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

message.reasoning:
We need to parse user request: "It's extremely hot today and my air conditioner is currently turned off. Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. power off after an hour"

We need to send a command via ThinQ_Connect. The body includes parameters: airConJobMode, windStrength, airConOperationMode, targetTemperature, relativeHourToStart, relativeHourToStop? Actually relativeHourToStop is number of hours from current time when the appliance should stop. relativeMinuteToStop is number of minutes from current time when the appliance should stop. We want to power off after an hour. So relativeHourToStop=1, relativeMinuteToStop=0. Also relativeHourToStart? The user says "Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength." That implies we want to start immediately? Or maybe start now? The user didn't specify a start time, so we can set relativeHourToStart=0, relativeMinuteToStart=0? But the function expects relativeHourToStart and relativeMinuteToStart to be null if not scheduled. But we can set them to 0 to start immediately? The function's default is null. But we can set relativeHourToStart=0, relativeMinuteToStart=0 to start now. Or we can leave them null and set airConOperationMode to POWER_ON to start now. But the user wants to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. So we set airConJobMode to COOL, windStrength to MID, targetTemperature to 20, airConOperationMode to POWER_ON. Then we schedule stop after an hour: relativeHourToStop=1, relativeMinuteToStop=0. We also set airConOperationMode to POWER_ON? But we also want to power off after an hour. The function can schedule stop. So we set relativeHourToStop=1, relativeMinuteToStop=0. We don't need to set airConOperationMode to POWER_OFF because we schedule stop. But we might set airConOperationMode to POWER_ON to start now. So final body: airConJobMode: "COOL", windStrength: "MID", airConOperationMode: "POWER_ON", targetTemperature: 20, relativeHourToStop: 1, relativeMinuteToStop: 0. Also relativeHourToStart and relativeMinuteToStart can be null. So we set them to null. Also we can set monitoringEnabled, powerSaveEnabled, airCleanOperationMode to defaults. So we send ThinQ_Connect with body: {airConJobMode:"COOL", windStrength:"MID", airConOperationMode:"POWER_ON", targetTemperature:20, relativeHourToStop:1, relativeMinuteToStop:0, relativeHourToStart:null, relativeMinuteToStart:null}. Also we might set monitoringEnabled: false, powerSaveEnabled: false, airCleanOperationMode: "STOP". But defaults are fine.

Thus we call ThinQ_Connect with body.
